items.title: Deni Avdija on ownership/arena drama: "I love the city of Portland. I really trust Tom and the action he takes. Hopefully there's an agreement, but that's above my pay grade. I don't know what happens behind closed doors, but I trust both sides. Both sides love the Blazers."

items.title: Deni Avdija says he's at 99.9% in terms of where he's at with his back.
items.author: Conor Bergin
items.body_excerpt:
Deni Avdija says he's at 99.9% in terms of where he's at with his back.

Says he had to get more treatment this offseason and work on moving more efficiently. The training staff did a great job building him a plan.
